extName.description: Product name. Shown in the store, the extensions page and the popup header. Max 75 characters.

extDescription.message: Altere a velocidade de vídeos na web de 0.25× a 16× pela barra de ferramentas ou por um pequeno painel no vídeo.

actionTitle.description: Tooltip of the toolbar button before any tab state is known.

statusOn.description: Extension state: enabled. Very short (header, badge tooltip).

statusOff.description: Extension state: disabled. Very short. Also shown large in the middle of the popup when disabled.

enableLabel.description: Accessible label of the master on/off switch.

reset.description: Visible text of the button that resets the speed to 1×.

resetLabel.description: Accessible label / tooltip of the reset button.

decrease.description: Accessible label of the minus button.

increase.description: Accessible label of the plus button.

speedInput.description: Accessible label of the numeric speed input.

speedSlider.description: Accessible label of the speed slider.

presets.description: Accessible label of the group of preset speed buttons.

presetLabel.description: Accessible label of a preset button.

savedSpeedWhenOn.description: Shown while disabled: the saved speed that will be used when the extension is turned on again.

showOverlay.description: Setting: show the small control panel on top of videos.

rememberSpeed.description: Setting: automatically apply the saved speed to newly found videos.

languageAuto.description: Language option that follows the browser language. Keep short.

opensNewTab.description: Screen-reader hint appended to the author link.

errLoadSettings.message: Não foi possível carregar as configurações. Abra esta janela novamente.
errLoadSettings.description: Error when the settings cannot be read when the popup opens.

errSaveSettings.message: Não foi possível salvar as configurações.
errSaveSettings.description: Error when saving settings or language failed.

errReload.message: Não foi possível recarregar a página.
errReload.description: Error when reloading the tab failed.

errInput.description: Error for empty, non-numeric or out-of-range input.

errNoTab.message: Não foi possível encontrar a guia a ser controlada. Abra esta janela novamente.
errNoTab.description: Error when there is no active tab.

msgReload.description: Guidance when the page does not respond (e.g. it was opened before the extension was installed).

reloadTab.description: Accessible label / tooltip of the icon-only reload button.

errCannotConfirm.message: Não foi possível confirmar a velocidade de reprodução.
errCannotConfirm.description: Error when, after a communication failure, the requested speed could not be observed.

msgNoVideo.description: Guidance when the page responded but contains no video.

errCannotChange.message: Não foi possível alterar a velocidade de reprodução.
errCannotChange.description: Error when the page or player rejected the speed change.

overlayRegion.description: Accessible name of the panel shown on top of a video.

overlayCurrent.message: Velocidade atual: $SPEED$. Clique para voltar para 1×
overlayCurrent.description: Accessible label / tooltip of the current-speed button on the video panel.

showDetails.description: Button on the video panel that opens the slider and presets.

hideDetails.description: Same button when the details are open.

fold.description: Button that shrinks the video panel to a small icon.

openController.description: Accessible label of the small icon that restores the collapsed video panel.
